note: Regulations and the product capabilities/rules that satisfy them. Not legal advice — a mapping to inform UX (why evidence, approvals, and reviews exist). 'satisfiedBy' references feature ids and BR- rule ids.

regulations.name: Sarbanes-Oxley
regulations.focus: Financial reporting integrity; access to financial systems must be controlled, reviewed, and separated.

regulations.name: GDPR
regulations.focus: Protection of personal data; least-privilege access and auditability of who accessed what.

regulations.name: HIPAA
regulations.focus: Protected health information; minimum-necessary access and audit trails.

regulations.name: SOC 2
regulations.focus: Trust criteria incl. logical access controls, change management, monitoring.

regulations.name: ISO/IEC 27001
regulations.focus: ISMS; access control policy, review of access rights, segregation of duties.

regulations.name: NIST 800-53 / CSF
regulations.focus: Access control (AC) family; least privilege, separation of duties, account management.
